title: world_map
summary: MSUI covers the observable behavior of Benilla's world_map module: Map.dbc is loaded as a catalog (directory + LoadingScreenID via DbcReader), the current map is authoritative session state, SMSG_NEW_WORLD performs the cross-map transition in one transaction (TearDownWorldContent, ADT streamer re-targeted to the new map directory, resident centre reset), and the loading screen resolves the map's real art through Map.dbc -> LoadingScreens.dbc.
